messages:
Marta: heads up — customer reported a weird case where a feature flag enabled a new UI for 10% of users but the rollout policy still sent 100% traffic to the old model. who should win when both exist?

Vikram: ugh that ambiguity again. I thought rollout policies (console) were supposed to be authoritative for traffic routing, flags only gate features. but it's fuzzy when flags also perform splits.

Leah: reality: both systems can express traffic splits. flags service has targeting rules, console rollout has traffic-split config and guards. we never defined precedence formally.

Sam-runtime: from runtime ops POV, we need a deterministic resolution: requests must map to a single source so caching and KV works. current impl picks "first match" by config insertion order -> not good.

Marta: exactly — we need explicit rules and a minimal change path. proposal: runtime resolution order = 1) runtime guard overrides (safety/kill-switch), 2) rollout policy (console) if it includes split for route, 3) feature-flag split, 4) fallback/default. thoughts?

Vikram: that aligns with product expectations (console manages rollouts). question: what about flags used by product teams to do A/B on UI + model together? they expect flag to control both UI and routing.

Leah: then flags should be able to opt-in to "take precedence" by setting an explicit priority, but that feels messy. alternative: expose an explicit mapping in console: route X can be delegated to flag Y. then only one source resolves.

Sam-runtime: delegation makes runtime simple: resolution returns {source: "rollout"|"flag", id: "..."}. we can add that to the policy RPC. example diff: 

```
// policy resolution response
{ "route": "/generate", "split": [{"variant":"v2","pct":10}], "source": "rollout", "source_id": "rollout-2026-03-19" }
```

Marta: +1 to the rpc source field. also: console UI should show origin next to each split, and the rollout API should reject ambiguous configs (both split and delegation unset).

Vikram: ops question: what about historical telemetry? we need to be able to attribute token counts and errors to the deciding source. add telemetry tag: policy_source.

Leah: agree. plan: 1) add source field to resolve API (sam implement), 2) console UX to surface source and a "delegate to flag" checkbox (marta + product), 3) docs + precedence table, 4) add policy_source tag to telemetry and existing backfill for recent 30 days.

Sam-runtime: timeline: I can prototype the API change and runtime behavior in a small PR next week. will default to rollout > flag until console delegation exists.

Marta: ok please also add a runtime warning log when ambiguity detected so we can find any remaining cases.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime/policy-resolver v0.9.3 -> staging :rocket:

Vikram: thanks. after PR let's do a short cross-team RFC and then force a UI validation to prevent accidental dual-splits.

Leah: sounds good. created a quick checklist in the thread: 
- add source field to RPC 
- telemetry tag policy_source 
- console UI surface + delegation UX 
- reject ambiguous configs in API 
- add runtime warning logs

Marta: assigning follow-ups: sam runtime API, leah docs/spec, vikram UI guard, marta product + acceptance tests. I'll draft RFC tomorrow. :+1:

Sam-runtime: noted. I'll post PR link here when ready.
